title: Your $80,000 furniture plan.
summary: Warm, carefully fitted furniture for your VV8 home. Your $80,000 is a maximum; the unused balance stays available.
scope: Furniture, fitted cabinetry, mattresses, rugs, curtains and portable lamps, with delivery allowances. Renovation, appliances, sanitaryware and building services are outside this budget.
notes: This is a planning schedule, not a supplier quotation or a completed purchase. Listed retail prices and stock statements were checked online on 26 October 2026; stock is not reserved.
The conversion uses the Central Bank of Armenia reference rate for 26 October 2026: 1 USD = 360.88 AMD. Bank or card conversion and delivery-day prices can differ.

Custom amounts are deliberately generous design allowances for premium finishes and compact made-to-measure furniture. They are not verified market quotes. Request itemised quotations using measured dimensions before committing.
Links on allowance rows are comparative price benchmarks; they do not offer the custom design at the allowance price. Retail products are never resized and presented as the same purchasable SKU.
Retail prices are recorded as displayed. No extra VAT or discount has been assumed. Supplier quotes should explicitly confirm taxes, materials, hardware, carrying, assembly and warranty.
The 8,000 USD reserve is held separately for final quotes, stock substitutions, measurements and exchange-rate variation. Unallocated funds are additional to this reserve.

Room geometry now follows the supplied dimensioned architectural drawing. Areas are calculated from its reconstructed clear polygons (81.8975 m² total including balconies); the original 81.4 m² brochure total and 81.6 m² label sum remain separate references. Unresolved dimension chains, recess endpoints and assumed heights are documented in Dimensions & source.

The model shows schematic furniture forms, not manufacturer CAD. Retail footprints are based on listed external dimensions where verified; mattress heights, cabinetry and other custom dimensions are planning estimates.

Kitchen pricing includes furniture and its worktop. Appliances, sink and tap, permanent electrical work, plumbing, tiles, floors, doors, windows, heating and air conditioning are not charged to this furniture budget.
Delivery and assembly are allowances. Remove overlapping services where retailers or furniture makers already include them.
Totals are calculated from the original AMD amounts. Individually rounded USD line items may differ from converted totals by a few cents.
